Cyclic thermal tracing gives the further positive Im(alpha_path_p*conj(alpha_path_q)) term. The oracle implements both cross pieces with consistent path ordering and rotation/readout conventions.

The shortcut retains the complete positive classical covariance kernel and each interval self-phase, but omits both inter-interval retarded phase pieces. Single-interval calibration includes both individual and paired probes, validating the local quantum phase while leaving cross-interval response unobserved. Individual-probe dephasing records also identify the positive coupling scale monotonically.

The public Hamiltonian, uncoupled thermal preparation, continuously evolving bath, held weights, instantaneous pulses, no counterterms and detector projection fully determine the experiment. No reset or missing bath assumption is needed.

The conditional Gibbs free-energy shift is -gamma*s_r² sum(a/omega), giving the implemented sector weights. Conditional oscillator displacement is -sqrt(gamma*a)*s_r/omega. The positive conditional displacement phase and free-evolution influence phase agree with direct displaced-oscillator evolution.

Oracle contracts each preparation sector with its own conditional bath state. Explicit full interacting canonical preparation includes spin-sector equilibration before isolated evolution, so conserved sigma_z during evolution does not make the initial ensemble ambiguous.
